title: Tour Old Town to gain insight aboutBarcelona ‘s history.
text: Our tour was around Barcelona’s oldest neighborhood where the Cathedra is located. In the same area are three columns from Roman times which are preserved as part of newer construction, which included the in the design.. our guide was exceptional, well versed on the history of Barcelona and the surrounding areas.
